title: Selling Plans Early Termination Fee — Calculation Sheet
content:
**Calculation.** On **Selling Plans**, the early termination fee is the plan's annual term monthly fee times the remaining committed months times the early termination share, rounded to the nearest cent. The remaining committed months are the billing dates still to come in the term: the whole calendar months from the next billing date to the term end date, plus one for the next billing date itself, and the early termination share is the plan's early termination fee share.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Annual term monthly fee | The plan's subscription schedule |
| Next billing date and term end date | The selling plan record |
| Early termination fee share | The plan's schedule of plan change, cancellation and early termination terms |

The three factors are multiplied together and the product is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end.

## Counting the remaining committed months (hypothetical dates)

| Next billing date | Term end date | Whole calendar months between | Plus the next billing date itself | Remaining committed months |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 June | 9 December | 5 | 1 | 6 (billing dates 10 June to 10 November) |
| 10 November | 9 December | 0 | 1 | 1 |

## Worked fee (hypothetical Premium Store)

Annual term monthly fee USD 59.95; next billing date 10 June; term end date 9 December; early termination fee share 50%.

- Remaining committed months: 6.
- Fee: 59.95 times 6 is 359.70; times 50% is USD 179.85.
